# Bundle Cop — full context for LLMs

Website: https://bundle-cop.vercel.app
Docs: https://bundle-cop.vercel.app/docs
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/bundle-cop-vercel-plugin
GitHub: https://github.com/nad33mahm3d/bundle-cop-vercel-plugin

## What it does

1. During `next build`, the adapter parses Next.js build output / manifests.
2. It attributes large modules to the importing user file (e.g. moment → app/page.tsx).
3. Optional budgets in bundle-cop.config.json can warn or fail the build.
4. Reports can upload to private Vercel Blob; the integration webhook diffs vs production and can post Checks.

## Package name

`bundle-cop-vercel-plugin` (unscoped). Peer: Next.js >= 16.

## Integration URLs

- Redirect / setup: https://bundle-cop.vercel.app/setup
- Dashboard: https://bundle-cop.vercel.app/dashboard
- Webhook: https://bundle-cop.vercel.app/api/webhooks/vercel
- Privacy: https://bundle-cop.vercel.app/privacy
